decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy was promoted to the home page in 2024, which signals results at or above aspiration, and it fits the firm's psychiatric core and statutory reimbursement, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
Senior living counseling has stayed on the home page for two years, costs little, and feeds the firm's residential care demand, so it meets aspiration and gives no reason to reallocate resources.

The sheltered workshop retail shop moved up to the home page in 2024, suggesting improving results, and after dropping the carpentry product the firm appears to be concentrating its workshop resources here.

Meal delivery is new, only mentioned on the website, and its results are still uncertain, but it complements senior care and is cheap enough that slack lets the firm carry it another year before judging it against aspiration.
